architectural_decisions.description: Standardized the usage of ScreenScaffold and TransformingLazyColumn to avoid screen cropping on circular watches with 372dp diameter.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Hardware limit of 372dp diameter cutoffs near extreme corners.

architectural_decisions.topic: Architecture modularity enforcing zero cross-feature dependency
architectural_decisions.description: Enforced strict decoupling of feature modules. Features communicate via Contract System defined inside the core module to prevent circular compilation paths.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Prevents cyclic project configurations and speeds up Gradle incremental configuration time.

architectural_decisions.description: Transitioned from browser-launched GitHub release links to direct background download stream with live percentage updates and secure FileProvider hands-off to prevent Wear OS memory overflows.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Android 8 constraints require sandboxed handoff of package managers via strict content authorities.

architectural_decisions.topic: Desacoplamento Estrito da Interface (UI) com a Camada de Dados (Data)
architectural_decisions.description: Toda comunicação entre UI e dados deve obrigatoriamente transitar por ViewModel e UseCase.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Garante isolamento dos dados de telemetria do Wear OS e permite testes independentes de interface.

historicalViolations.message: Unresolved reference 'javax.inject.Inject' in pure JVM Domain layer.
historicalViolations.fixAction: Refactored DownloadUpdateUseCase constructor to use Constructor Injection and registered factory provider inside data layer UseCaseModule manually.

correctionsApplied.action: Ensure all modules have uniform ui, vm, and state internal package partitions to pass static Architecture Lint rule standard checks automatically.

detectedPatterns.description: ViewModel importing UI packages, usually caused by lazy usage of Compose standard colors or icons. ViewModels must rely strictly on domain models or primitive states.
detectedPatterns.remediation: Encourage mapped visual UI state resource configurations or ID bindings.

detectedPatterns.description: Direct cross-domain boundary coupling between business logic scopes.
detectedPatterns.remediation: Always pass state actions or merge domain tasks inside single-focused composite view model flows.

learnedRules.name: Single source of truth in state
learnedRules.description: Actions must mutate UI State solely through flows inside ViewModels. Events must never persist to avoid Wear OS background recycling state mismatch errors.

learnedRules.name: Circular Screen Boundary Margins
learnedRules.description: All lists operating near physical smartwatch edges must wrap under TransformingLazyColumn scroll adjustments or dynamic inner content safe areas.

recommendations.title: Formulate migration path for LEGACY modules
recommendations.description: Modules such as [feature-sensors] are running under LEGACY rules. Guide them to STABLE state through partition refactoring.

feature-settings.notes: Desacoplamento absoluto completo e cobertura de testes visuais assegurada.

activeRules.name: Strict Layer Coupling Blocking
activeRules.description: Impede importação de Repositories ou DataSources diretamente na camada de UI.

activeRules.name: No Cross-Feature Dependence
activeRules.description: Proíbe dependência física direta de compilação entre dois módulos de feature.

activeRules.name: Circular Safe Area Enforcement
activeRules.description: Força uso de componentes que calculam recortes de tela circular (API 26).

activeRules.name: Minimum Touch Target Density
activeRules.description: Engloba detecção de botões ou elementos com dimensões menores de 48dp.

activeRules.name: Required ViewModel Suffix Pattern
activeRules.description: Obriga que classes sob o pacote /vm terminem estritamente com o sufixo 'ViewModel'.

deprecatedRules.name: Single View Navigation Block
deprecatedRules.description: Impedia rotas com parâmetros compostos no Wear OS antigo.
deprecatedRules.reason: Substituído utilizando chaves serializáveis completas e type-safe navigation em Kotlin.

ruleHistory.details: Regra inicial contra vazamento de persistência de dados para o Compose Canvas.
Regra de acoplamento inter-features ativada sob contratos estritamente rígidos.
Depreciação de bloqueios antigos de navegação.
Validadores circulares visando displays de reformatagem de insets adicionados ao layout.
Ativação de barreiras de conferência de tamanho físico clicável mínimo de componentes.
Inclusão estrita do padrão nominal para classes da ViewModel.
